master_program.OBJECTIVE: Transform the integrated CeutIA + SERPIENTE architecture into an operational, testable, scientifically defensible territorial scientific machine; audit the complete chain from real-world observation through acquisition, temporal/spatial semantics, state, dynamics, interaction, forecasting, uncertainty, early warning, decision and prospective evaluation.
master_program.OPERATING_RULE: Architecture, documentation, registry entries and unit tests are not sufficient evidence of operational capability. Each capability must be traced to executable runtime behaviour, validation and explicit external/prospective dependencies.
master_program.CURRENT_FRONTIER: Acquisition/process integrity and real-source operationalization are now the highest-centrality open layer after PIT binding and basic interaction evaluation. SERPIENTE has a generic poller and verified source catalog, but source-process health/schema-drift detection was not previously explicit.

master_program.BIBLIOGRAPHY_POLICY: Treat accumulated bibliography as a source of scientific constraints and engineering requirements; distinguish verified literature, conceptual constraints, inferred requirements, implementation requirements, local empirical results and prospective validation. Never upgrade literature support into local validity.
